criteria.description: (R1, R3) `from app_int.main import cube` succeeds, and `cube` is a callable defined in src/app_int/main.py that accepts exactly one positional argument.
(R4) At least one test function in a file under tests/ imports cube from app_int.main and asserts on its return value, and that test passes under `uv run pytest -q`.
(R5) health_check() still returns {"status": "ok"} and add(2, 3) still returns 5; the pre-existing tests in tests/test_main.py are still present and pass.
(R6) `uv run pytest -q` exits with status 0 and reports no failures or errors.
(R6) `uv run ruff check .` exits with status 0.
(R7) The cube function definition has type annotations on its parameter and return value and has a non-empty docstring.
